Reaper Farm is a yield optimizer that automatically compounds rewards for users. Reaper Farm operates on the Fantom blockchain. Reaper Farm issues the REAP governance token.

Beefy is a yield optimizer that auto-compounds rewards from liquidity pools and vaults. Beefy operates across multiple public blockchains. Beefy issues the BIFI governance token.

Bent Finance is a lending and borrowing protocol. Bent Finance operates on the Fantom blockchain. Bent Finance issues the BENT governance token.

Balancer is an automated market maker that enables token swaps and liquidity provision. Balancer uses pools with customizable token weights. Balancer operates on the Ethereum blockchain and other public chains. Balancer issues the BAL governance token.

Grim Finance is a yield optimizer that automatically compounds rewards for users. Grim Finance operates on the Fantom blockchain. Grim Finance issues the GRIM governance token.
